protocol.aa_noise: absolute profile differences between adjacent independent rgflux replicates

plane_coordinate_absolute_tolerance.rationale: Deterministically generated double-precision uniform plane grids must match after normalization.

profile_energy_scale_multiplier.rationale: Twice the independently defined exact or static barrier is a broad physical corruption bound, not an engine-equivalence claim.

static_energy_absolute_tolerance.rationale: The same double-precision potential and coordinates must agree to a numerical identity tolerance.

statistical_se_multiplier.rationale: Five combined standard errors give a conservative two-engine sampling-agreement bound without using observed profile differences.

force_call_accounting.lammps_pafi: derived as planes times configured thermalization plus production steps; setup evaluations are excluded

protocol.order: interleaved and reversed on alternating replicates
protocol.rejection_classification: A reactant-partition rejection is reproduced_reactant_partition only when the rgflux run has exactly the configuration that the cargo test and repro_zero_width_reactant_partition.py reject with that error; every other run with that error is unclassified_reactant_partition. No record is attributed to a cause the guards do not observe.
